configuration.title: Keel
configuration.language.description: Language for Keel's summaries and webview.
configuration.quarantineDays.description: Do not recommend versions published fewer than this many days ago (except for critical vulnerabilities).
configuration.snykOrgId.description: Snyk organization ID used as a second reference (Snyk's API generally requires an Enterprise plan; without it, Keel uses OSV). The token is stored with the 'Keel: Set Snyk Token' command.
configuration.validationScripts.descript: Project scripts to run after applying changes. Invalid script names are ignored.
configuration.pullRequestBaseBranch.desc: Base branch for pull requests. Leave empty to use the repository default branch.
